title.zh: 上下文窗口管理方法论

question.zh: 会话越长 agent 越笨,怎么管理上下文窗口,让它一直保持在「聪明区」?
question.en: Agents get dumber as a session gets longer. How do you manage the context window so the agent stays in the "smart zone"?

text.zh: 上下文窗口装得越满,模型就越笨。所以要让每个任务都在 smart zone 里完成:缩减常驻的系统提示词和指令;一件事做完就选择清空、压缩、交接给新会话,或者交给子 agent;长任务在任务之间主动重置上下文。
text.en: The fuller the context window, the dumber the model. So finish every task inside the smart zone: trim the always-loaded system prompt and instructions; when a piece of work is done, choose to clear, compact, hand off to a new session or pass to a sub-agent; on long jobs, reset the context between tasks on purpose.

anchors.quote: A bowl is most useful when it is empty - Lao Tzu
anchors.quote_zh: 碗空着的时候最有用——老子
你的上下文窗口也一样

how.zh: 知道 token、上下文窗口、消息历史是怎么回事,才能理解为什么聊得越久效果越差。
how.en: Know what tokens, the context window and message history are, and it becomes clear why results get worse the longer a chat goes on.

anchors.quote: It might be because you don't understand how context windows work.
anchors.quote_zh: 可能是因为你不理解上下文窗口是怎么工作的。

how.zh: 上下文用到一定程度之后,决策、代码质量和指令遵循都会明显下降。超大上下文窗口并不意味着应该把它用满。
how.en: Past a certain level of context use, decisions, code quality and instruction-following all drop noticeably. A huge context window does not mean you should fill it.

anchors.quote: The drop-off in quality is really noticeable.
1m context windows are a nice gimmick
anchors.quote_zh: 1M 上下文窗口是个不错的噱头

title.en: Trim what is always in context

how.zh: 每次请求都会带上系统提示词、工具定义和指令文件。先看清实际发送了什么,再关掉用不上的功能,删掉没有用的指令。
how.en: Every request carries the system prompt, tool definitions and instruction files. Look at what is actually sent, then turn off features you don't use and delete instructions that don't help.

anchors.quote: Run a proxy so you can see exactly what gets sent to Claude Code
anchors.quote_zh: 运行一个代理,看清到底给 Claude Code 发了什么

title.zh: 一段工作结束时,选一种方式继续
title.en: When a piece of work ends, choose how to continue

how.zh: 有几种选择:在当前会话里继续、清空、压缩、把状态写成交接文档交给新会话,或者交给子 agent。交接比压缩更灵活,可以把一个想法交给另一个 agent 去实现,再把结果交回来。
how.en: The options: keep going in this session, clear, compact, write the state into a handoff document for a new session, or pass it to a sub-agent. A handoff is more flexible than compacting: you can pass an idea to another agent to build and get the result back.

anchors.quote: Here's a decision tree for when you get to the end of a piece of work
anchors.quote_zh: 这是一段工作结束、不知道怎么继续时的决策树

anchors.quote: It's an alternative to /compact that gives you WAY more flexibility with your context window.
anchors.quote_zh: 它是 /compact 的替代方案,让你对上下文窗口有大得多的灵活性。

title.zh: 长任务在任务之间重置
title.en: Reset between tasks on long jobs

how.zh: 连续跑多个任务时,每个任务都从干净的上下文开始(Ralph 的核心),或者在任务之间压缩一次,别让一个会话一路滑进 dumb zone。
how.en: When running several tasks in a row, start each from a clean context (the core of Ralph), or compact between tasks, so one session doesn't slide into the dumb zone.

anchors.quote: to aggressively clear the context window on each task to keep the LLM in the smart zone.
anchors.quote_zh: 每个任务都积极清空上下文窗口,让 LLM 待在 smart zone。
让 agent 在任务之间执行 /compact

title.en: Feel the difference with an experiment

how.zh: agent 犯了蠢错时,回退到出错之前,压缩上下文后重跑一次,对比结果,亲身体会上下文过满的影响。
how.en: When the agent makes a silly mistake, roll back to before it, compact the context and run it again. Compare the results to see for yourself what an overfull context does.

anchors.quote: Here's a way to get a visceral sense of the dumb zone
anchors.quote_zh: 这里有个办法,能让你直观感受 dumb zone

title.zh: 本站示例:交接文档骨架
title.en: Our example: a handoff document skeleton

body.zh:
# 交接:草稿自动保存
已决定:保存走 debounce;草稿存本地
已完成:保存按钮 + 测试(已提交)
未完成:离线提示
下一步:读 GLOSSARY.md,从「离线提示」那张票开始
body.en:
# Handoff: draft autosave
Decided: saving is debounced; drafts are stored locally
Done: save button + tests (committed)
Not done: offline notice
Next: read GLOSSARY.md, start with the "offline notice" ticket

text.zh: 以为窗口大就可以一直聊下去。
text.en: Thinking a big window means you can keep chatting forever.

text.zh: 把多个任务塞进同一个越来越长的上下文。
text.en: Packing several tasks into one context that keeps growing.

anchors.quote: It defeats the entire purpose of Ralph
anchors.quote_zh: 这完全违背了 Ralph 的初衷

text.zh: 拷问时滑进 dumb zone,或者反过来,清空上下文太早。
text.en: Sliding into the dumb zone while grilling, or the opposite, clearing the context too early.

text.zh: 让全局指令文件越积越多。
text.en: Letting global instruction files keep growing.

anchors.quote: You've overloaded your global steering files
anchors.quote_zh: 你的全局引导文件塞得太满了

stance.zh: 强调先懂基础:token、上下文窗口、消息。
stance.en: He stresses the basics first: tokens, the context window, messages.

stance.zh: 提出 smart zone / dumb zone,用来解释 Ralph 每轮为什么要清空上下文;亲自实验确认,上下文很深时质量明显下降。
stance.en: He introduces the smart zone and dumb zone to explain why Ralph clears the context every round, and confirms by experiment that quality drops when the context is deep.

stance.zh: 用交接(/handoff)替代压缩;给出一段工作结束后如何继续的决策树;缩减系统提示词里的冗余。
stance.en: Handoff (/handoff) replaces compacting; he gives a decision tree for continuing after a piece of work, and trims redundancy from system prompts.
